title: Transpose Matrix
summary: Return a matrix whose rows are the original columns.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–1000 rows and columns, with at most 100000 cells total. Values are in [−1000000000,1000000000].
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned intgrid.

statement: Return a matrix whose rows are the original columns. A value at input row r and column c moves to output row c and column r.

examples.explanation: A single cell stays at the same index.

constraints: 1–1000 rows and columns, with at most 100000 cells total. Values are in [−1000000000,1000000000].
hints: Conceptual: The row and column roles exchange.
Directional: Allocate the output with reversed dimensions.
Implementation: Copy each input cell to the position obtained by swapping its two indices.
complexityAnalysis: O(mn) time and O(mn) output space, with O(1) additional indexing state.
